title: On $\boldsymbolΣ^1_3$- and $Σ^1_4$-uniformization
summary: Assuming the consistency of $\mathsf{ZFC}$, we construct a model of set theory in which the boldface $\mathbfΣ^1_3$-uniformization property holds, yet the lightface $Σ^1_4$-uniformization property fails, separating these two principles for the first time. We also indicate how to create a universe where $Σ^1_3$-uniformization holds, but $Σ^1_4$-uniformization fails using inner models with large cardinals.
